sceneEdits.note: FP2: the kit's own silver parallel rule (z 235 mm) sat 65 mm behind the easel rail (z 300) and rendered as a second dark bar across the board's front (render PC, 12.4 s). The rail is the drafting bar now; the kit's rule and its tick marks are hidden for the film.
FP2: the parallel rule's tick marks

sceneEdits.label: Bamboo behind the bust
sceneEdits.note: FP2 planter repeat (notes-decor whole film 1): the room's second identical ergoflex-plant-2 (behind the bust, final hero frame) is hidden by the Director prop edit and replaced here with decor-bamboo (room frame: Room:creative is yawed 90 deg, so local (x, z) = (-world z, world x)). Hand-made, not a Director add, so the recolor below can follow it.
FP2: the pack bamboo's bright lime atlas taken down to a deep sage so it sits with the room's sage, terracotta and white

sceneEdits.label: Stool: out of the ending
sceneEdits.note: S12 (Nov 15): from 19.5 s (the cut to Lin painting) Lin stands where the stool was (people-lin-stand-paint at [-200, -130]; side and top stills showed her legs through its seat), so the stool is drawn only before the cut. The closing camera never shows the floor where it stood, so it is simply out of the shot.
